_about: HISTORICAL, frozen: the resource facts of the last ESP32-C3 SuperMini firmware build (physical-st7789 release ELF), which the v1 virtual Pip (`KIVORI_VIRTUAL_BOARD` unset or c3-supermini) reports in its Device internals. No firmware is built for that board any more, so this file is no longer checked against the product ELF; v2 has resource-facts-rp2040.json, which is. The `board` block is the unit's flash layout (4 MiB module, espflash default partition table, factory app 0x3F0000 B), as the unit's internals panel showed it. See docs/virtual-pip.md (Virtual boards, Modelled timing and internals).
